card.line: Bethlehem is a town in Judah, also called Ephrath, where Rachel was buried, where David's story began, and where the promised ruler of Israel was to come from.

moments.title: Rachel is buried
moments.text: Rachel died on the way to Ephrath, which is Bethlehem, and was buried there. Jacob set up a pillar on her grave.

moments.title: Naomi and Ruth arrive
moments.text: Naomi came back from Moab with her daughter-in-law Ruth. They arrived in Bethlehem at the start of the barley harvest.

moments.title: Samuel visits Jesse
moments.text: The LORD sent Samuel to Bethlehem. The elders trembled and asked if he came in peace, and he said he came to sacrifice to the LORD.

moments.title: Water from the well
moments.text: David longed for water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem. Three mighty men broke through the Philistine camp to get it, but David poured it out to the LORD.

moments.title: The ruler from Bethlehem
moments.text: After Jesus was born in Bethlehem, Magi came looking for the newborn King. The chief priests and scribes told Herod the prophet said a ruler and shepherd of God's people would come out of Bethlehem.
